title: Tower Records Online confirms external intrusion and customer data breach
geo_basis: country as stated by the source; no city given
summary: Security NEXT reports that Tower Records confirmed an external intrusion into its Tower Records Online store on 19 November 2026 and suspended the service for emergency maintenance. Security NEXT puts the number of records at 約1100万件 (stated in Japanese), including email addresses, member IDs and password hashes, and some names, birth dates and shipping details. As of 21 November it had seen no secondary damage.
plain: Tower Records says its online store was hacked and customer records are affected (約1100万件 per Security NEXT). The service is suspended and customers are being emailed.
exec: Customer records (約1100万件 per Security NEXT) are affected at a Japanese music retailer's online store.
action: Tower Records warns customers to be cautious of messages that pretend to come from Tower Records or related parties.

evidence.quote: 流出対象となった個人情報の件数は約1100万件。
2026年11月19日に同サイトで外部からの侵害を確認。

validation.note: One page read: Security NEXT relaying Tower Records' notice. The company's own notice was not found; searches did not surface it.

review.note: Compared title, 19 Nov date, 1100万 figure, data types, service suspension, no secondary damage 21 Nov, customer warning against Security NEXT
